standardized_50m_reference.note: 2026 cohort is a same-session photoelectric 50m test and is therefore eligible for the standardized reference.

interval_method.assumption: velocity is non-decreasing from start through 50m
interval_method.purpose: derive a coefficient-free protocol-local bound, not a Statcast T90 estimate
interval_method.guardrail: The intervals appear materially faster than the known Statcast T90 scale, which is evidence that start/timing protocol equivalence cannot be assumed. Do not feed these bounds into production T90 without a protocol bridge.

verdict: Adding the independent 2026 50m cohort expands the standardized reference from 57 to 88 without changing the existing three-player profile labels.
Only two exact 30m values are verified in the official public article; the other 29 remain null and must not be inferred.
The same-trial 30m/50m pairs are valuable profile evidence but are not yet a calibrated Statcast-equivalent T90 source.
Keep all 30m/50m profile effects in shadow mode; production speed ratings remain unchanged.
